mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 54 degrees and a Full Moon. Please be aware that the air quality index is currently at 51, which is considered moderate.

The City of Verona has announced that a segment of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7. This closure will allow crews to complete final asphalt and pavement marking work, so please use the detours on Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street.

We have a busy schedule ahead in Verona. Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, local trivia options include Hop Haus Brewing, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, join us on September 30 for the Downtown Farmer's Market or Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
In a report from September 5, Verona police officers noted a strange trend where multiple vehicles were found with slices of cheese on their windshields, identified as a viral social media prank.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
